notes.title: 🛠️ Megabattle Demo – Smarter Battles & UI Upgrades (v1.0.4)
notes.notes:
[h2]🛠️ Megabattle Demo – Smarter Battles & UI Upgrades (v1.0.4)[/h2][p]Hey pilots![/p][p]We’ve just deployed [b]version 1.0.4[/b] of the [i]Megabattle[/i] demo, and it’s packed with quality-of-life improvements, visual polish, and a smarter battle experience. While this isn’t a full content update, it brings crucial refinements that make fights feel more responsive, strategic, and satisfying.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧠 Smarter Combat[/h3][p]Introducing the [b]Damage Predictor[/b]:
You can now preview how your attack will affect the enemy’s [b]armor[/b], [b]integrity[/b], and special traits like [b]plated[/b] and [b]spiked[/b] — even during enemy turns.
This makes planning your moves much more transparent and strategic.[/p][p]We also added a [b]radar effect[/b] that shows when your parts are being targeted — giving you more clarity on incoming threats.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]👁️ Visual Feedback & UI Polish[/h3][list][*][p][b]Turn display[/b] is now centered and more prominent (“Your Turn” / “Enemy Turn”).[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy hands now retain played cards with a transparent effect — you can track what’s been used.[/p][/*][*][p]Cards now have [b]hover effects[/b] in rewards and battles that feel more responsive.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]workshop panel[/b] now only shows [b]unequipped parts[/b], making management easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Stats like [b]PWR[/b], [b]DEF[/b], and status effects now use icons (ongoing update).[/p][/*][*][p]Battle tooltips have been reworked to avoid visual clutter and now scale with text.[/p][/*][*][p]ESC now opens [b]settings[/b] in battle (soon across all menus).[/p][/*][*][p]Deck and discard [b]buttons + tooltips[/b] are now functional during and after battles.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧪 System Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Power-up cards now require a [b]confirmation click[/b] after placing them in the center.[/p][/*][*][p]Robots start with a [b]weak torso[/b], but can equip a standard one with a modifier — a meaningful early-game decision.[/p][/*][*][p]Better [b]hover zones[/b] for cards in the hand (you don’t have to go all the way up to un-hover).[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]tutorial triggers[/b] to help first-time players.[/p][/*][*][p]And yes, the card and part [b]emoji cleanup[/b] is in progress![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes & Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed map nodes spawning too close together.[/p][/*][*][p]Recharge cards now work correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed area-of-effect prediction bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected lingering buffs like [b]Ionic Overflow[/b] lasting between battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Acidic Conduit now correctly triggers synergy effects with cards like [b]Sulfuric Veins[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The integrity bar has been stabilized to stop it from shifting unexpectedly.[/p][/*][*][p]Two cards that weren’t displaying blocked parts in gray now work properly.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]💬 Why this update matters[/h3][p]Version 1.0.4 brings [i]Megabattle[/i] a big step closer to the feel we’re aiming for: smart, tactical, and visually clear combat where decisions matter. We're listening closely to your feedback and making steady progress toward launch.[/p][p]Coming next:[/p][list][*][p]Deeper deckbuilding tools[/p][/*][*][p]More visual effects for hits and abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Continued balancing and clarity improvements[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]👉 [b]Play the updated demo now[/b]:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602030/MegaBattle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Join our Discord and help shape the game[/b]:
[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/PZMjvf9Y"]https://discord.gg/PZMjvf9Y[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your ongoing support — and stay tuned for more robotic mayhem!
Let’s keep improving this card battler together. ⚡🤖[/p][p]— Team Mad Cat Corp[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Megabattle Demo – Gameplay & Balance Update (v1.0.3)

notes.title: Gamescom Latam
notes.notes:
Greetings, human warriors of the MegaBattle community!

This past weekend, the MegaBattle team attended Gamescom LATAM! While we didn’t have a special booth for the game at the event this year, we still got to meet other devs, talk about games, make connections, receive feedback, and even attended a special Steam Q&A where we got to hear from other developers and members of the Valve team about how to improve our experience here on Steam and with our production pipeline as a whole.

We look forward to improving our communication with our community, to bring you news more often, and to grow our support from gamers, especially those who love roguelike deckbuilders. Not only we’re looking to expand our playerbase, but also we’d love to have more feedback that could make MegaBattle into an awesome gaming experience.

If you’d like to help us gain such traction, head on over to our Discord server and connect with us! Also, of course, if you haven’t played our demo already, be sure to do so! Keep an eye out for more updates, as we plan to deliver them more consistently.

Discord link -> http://discord.gg/XDbax6NTx4

Thanks for the support,

Madcat Corp., The MegaBattle Team

notes.title: Dev updates | New cards, gameplay balance & bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Our last demo build has been out for some months now, and, since then, our team has been working hard to bring big changes to the next build. We’ve been holding frequent meetings about our game design and how to make it deep, interesting, and close to what we envisioned for a thrilling deckbuilder experience!

As some of you might know, our combat system includes cards that are tied to specific robot parts and classes, which allows for diverse fights and strategies where the player can experiment, mix, and match powers and cards to fit their preferred style. To make our backend development process more efficient and allow for deeper experimentation, our dev team is working on a special tool that allows us to test different cards and robots with different parts and classes. Our system is working so well, in fact, that we’re also thinking about other ways to implement its use, including making it available eventually to players who also want to test and customize their battles.

Many facets of our operation have gone through some restructuring since our last update, but we’re still diligent in our work and hope to bring you a new build soon! In the meantime, feel welcome to join our official Discord server where you can provide feedback to our game and also keep up with devlogs! We’d love to have our community expand, so hop in and let’s make it happen!

Discord link -> http://discord.gg/XDbax6NTx4

Wishlist -> https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602030/MegaBattle/

Sincerely,

The MegaBattle team

notes.title: New demo 🔥🔥
notes.notes:
Attention, gamers and thrill-seekers! We are happy to unveil the highly anticipated free demo of MegaBattle, our action-packed roguelike! 


🚀 What is MegaBattle? 🌍

MegaBattle is a roguelike card game that combines strategic deckbuilding elements with the thrill of epic robot battles. Build a custom deck and embark on a procedurally generated journey, facing increasingly challenging trials.

🌟 Key Features of the Demo 🎯

- Engage in epic battles against other bots using your robot parts and battle deck 
- Unleash your strategy skills discovering cards of attack and defense (more cards are coming!)
- Upgrade your bot mix and matching different bots classes (2 classes available for the demo)
- Gain rewards and upgrade your battle deck

🎮 Who are we? 🦾

MadCat is an indie studio from Brazil and MegaBattle is our first game. This is our second demo release and after several months of development we make a lot of changes and progression. We hope you enjoy and we value your feeback, 


🔥 Join the MegaBattle Community! 🌐

We value your feedback and want to hear about your adventures in the MegaBattle demo. Please join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/GT3nUpMJ

Thanks for you support and we hope you enjoy playing MegaBattle.

- Megabattle team

notes.title: Free Demo Available
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

We are happy to announce that our free demo is available. You will be able to build your bot using parts from 2 mecha manufacturers (Pyron and Freezeltronic), choose your upgrades and powerups to build your battle strategy and fight in the arena. In each turn you can use your battery to attack or recover your bot and also you have a chance to defend your bot from enemy´s attack.

This demo should be a sample of what you can expect from the core gameplay and we are developing a roguelike sequence with more robots, upgrades, powerups and arenas to battle.  
Tho, it's a beta, a few bugs and issues are likely to show up.
I'll be looking forward to your feedback and impressions!

Enjoy,
MadCat

notes.title: New gameplay coming soon - Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Here is Leo, I´m MadCat Corp´s  game designer and this is our first devlog to share some news about MegaBattle´s development. 

MegaBattle was created based on card and deckbuilding players feedbacks (I´m included, as I´m a big fan of this game genre) and also to engage new players. My main inspiration for Megabattle was to create a fast paced gameplay, that combines the strategy of a deckbuilding game and the excitment of a fight game. 

To conquer that goal, we have an amazing team, composed by 3 devs (Luis from Cavylabs, Luiza and Alexandre), artwork by Leonardo Amora, UI by Fabrício Mazzoti and marketing by Thais.  ːsteamhappyː

We launched on August a pre-alpha release and we got some very good feedback to improve the game. Based on that, we are now working on improving our UI/UX to make it more intuitive and clean, adding some special effects and also developing a new gameplay mode more fun and exciting.
To test the new gameplay, we used Tabletop Simulator as a prototyping tool (as you can see below, looks a little messy, but it helped a lot!!) Now, we are working on developping this new gameplay on Unity and also we´re hiring a tech artist to joint the team. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318455/558530e2e1e48f0a7b3f89769ca93e815ff5aac7.gif[/img]

We believe that we should create games for players and they are an important part of the development process. If you want to be part of our alpha/beta tests and give us your feedback, please reach us on discord:  https://discord.gg/XDbax6NTx4

See you next Devlog!
